ITEM 1 | Long thin green spears, bright green with slightly darker tips, firm and straight, lying across the left and center of the plate, cut ends blunt; about 15 spears, each roughly 15-20 cm long and 1 cm thick, covering about 25% of plate | 110
ITEM 2 | White cooked grains, fluffy and separate, moist-looking with slight sheen, mounded on the left edge of the plate with a few tan flecks mixed in; footprint about 6 x 8 cm, about 2.5 cm tall | 120
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown glazed chunk with darker crusty edges, slightly sticky sheen, studded with small pale seeds or nut pieces on top; roughly 5 x 4 cm, about 2.5 cm thick, sitting at upper center of the plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Pale beige to off-white sliced meat, moist and smooth-surfaced with a fine grain, cut into three overlapping slices on the right, each about 6 x 4 cm and 1 cm thick, with a slightly pinkish edge | 110
ITEM 5 | Browned, seared piece with a crisp, deep golden surface and flaky, light interior edges, sitting center-right; about 7 x 5 cm and 1.5 cm thick, with some glaze residue | 85
ITEM 6 | Flat, dark golden-brown fried fillet with crisp, slightly charred edges and a dry matte surface, lower right of the plate; about 8 x 6 cm and 1 cm thick | 80
ITEM 7 | Small scattered toasted nut pieces, pale tan and irregular, scattered across the top and center of the plate; a few pieces about 0.5-1 cm each | 8
ITEM 8 | Thin translucent pale yellow-green strip, soft and slightly glossy, lying across the right center beside the meat; about 6 x 1 cm | 10
ITEM 9 | Small smear and bits of reddish-brown sauce, glossy and slightly thick, dotting the rice and plate edge near the lower left; roughly 4 x 3 cm in total spread | 6
